name: Arvenne
summary: Arvenne is shaped by luminous contrasts. Its frame in brushed brass stainless steel brings a subtle warmth and enduring strength, while the body, finished in radiant Koto veneer, shimmers with refined brilliance. A mirrored back enhances the depth of the design, reflecting light with quiet elegance. The drawer, lined in soft fabric, introduces a tactile intimacy that completes the piece. Balanced between structure and detail, Arvenne embodies sophistication with a timeless modern spirit.
